name: zopkit-bug-resolution-mcp
description: MCP server + status-line/hook reporters for Zopkit wrapper bug reports: fetch full bug context (with screenshots), submit how a bug was fixed, list bugs assigned to you, file new bug reports, and report REAL Claude Code usage — live per-session context and account rate limits via the status line, plus per-bug token attribution via PostToolUse hooks. Requires a BUG_REPORT_API_KEY (generated in the company-admin panel) — see README.md.
